response.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT ab.abhvreg, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as behaviour_count,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as total
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    behaviour_count,
    CAST(behaviour_count AS REAL) / CAST(total AS REAL) as share
  FROM grouped
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as baseline_share FROM with_share
)
SELECT 
  ordertypedist,
  behaviour_count,
  share,
  share - (SELECT baseline_share FROM baseline) as above_baseline
FROM with_share
WHERE share > (SELECT baseline_share FROM baseline)
ORDER BY share DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Simple average of shares" means the arithmetic mean: (sum of all group shares) / (number of groups). Mathematically this equals 1/(number of distinct ordertypedist values).
NULL values in ordertypedist are grouped together as a single distinct group, treated equally in baseline calculations.
